info.title: zoom (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Zoom Meeting API v2. All requests require Authorization: Bearer {token}. Meeting IDs are numeric. Use 'me' as userId for the authenticated user.

get.summary: Retrieve all meetings for a given user, including upcoming and past sessions. Supports filtering by meeting type.
get.description: Retrieve all meetings for a given user, including upcoming and past sessions. Supports filtering by meeting type.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user's ID or email address. Use 'me' to refer to the currently authenticated user.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type of meetings to return: scheduled, live, or upcoming (default 'live').

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: How many records to include per page (default 30, maximum 300).

parameters.name: next_page_token
parameters.description: Pagination cursor to fetch the following page of results.

parameters.name: page_number
parameters.description: Page index to return (deprecated; use next_page_token instead).

200.description: {page_count, page_number, page_size, total_records, next_page_token, meetings: [{uuid, id, host_id, topic, type, start_time, duration, timezone, created_at, join_url}]}

post.summary: Schedule a new Zoom meeting for the specified user.
post.description: Schedule a new Zoom meeting for the specified user.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user's ID or email address. Use 'me' to refer to the currently authenticated user.

200.description: 201 Created: {uuid, id, host_id, topic, type, start_time, duration, timezone, created_at, agenda, join_url, password}

requestBody.description: Body: {topic (string), type (integer: 1=instant, 2=scheduled, 3=recurring no fixed time, 8=recurring fixed time; default 2), start_time (ISO 8601 UTC), duration (minutes, default 60), timezone (string, e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles'), password (string, max 10 chars â€” meeting passcode), agenda (string), host_email (string), registration_required (boolean), settings: {approval_type (0=auto approve, 1=manual), waiting_room (boolean)}}

get.summary: Retrieve the full details of a specific Zoom meeting using its ID.
get.description: Retrieve the full details of a specific Zoom meeting using its ID.

parameters.name: meetingId
parameters.description: The identifier of the target meeting.

200.description: {uuid, id, host_id, topic, type, start_time, duration, timezone, created_at, agenda, join_url, password}

patch.summary: Modify an existing Zoom meeting. Only the fields provided in the request body are changed.
patch.description: Modify an existing Zoom meeting. Only the fields provided in the request body are changed.

parameters.name: meetingId
parameters.description: The identifier of the meeting to update.

200.description: 204 No Content on success (empty JSON object)

requestBody.description: Body (all optional): {topic, type (1, 2, 3, or 8), start_time, duration, timezone, password (passcode), agenda}

get.summary: Retrieve all registrants and participants for a Zoom meeting, with optional filtering by approval status.
get.description: Retrieve all registrants and participants for a Zoom meeting, with optional filtering by approval status.

parameters.name: meetingId
parameters.description: The identifier of the target meeting.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Restrict results to registrants with this approval status.

200.description: {page_count, page_size, total_records, registrants: [{id, email, first_name, last_name, status, create_time, join_url}], participants: [Participant]}

post.summary: Register a new attendee for a Zoom meeting. When auto-approve is enabled (approval_type=0), the registrant is confirmed
post.description: Register a new attendee for a Zoom meeting. When auto-approve is enabled (approval_type=0), the registrant is confirmed automatically.

parameters.name: meetingId
parameters.description: The identifier of the target meeting.

200.description: 201 Created: {registrant_id, id (meeting id), topic, start_time, join_url}

requestBody.description: Body: {email (required, string), first_name (required, string), last_name (required, string), language (optional, string)}

post.summary: Register a new attendee for a Zoom webinar (type=2 meeting).
post.description: Register a new attendee for a Zoom webinar (type=2 meeting).

parameters.name: webinarId
parameters.description: The identifier of the target webinar.

200.description: 201 Created: {registrant_id, id (webinar id), topic, start_time, join_url}

requestBody.description: Body: {email (required, string), first_name (required, string), last_name (optional, string), registrants_confirmation_email (optional, boolean, default true)}

get.summary: Retrieve cloud recordings for a user. Supports narrowing results by meeting topic.
get.description: Retrieve cloud recordings for a user. Supports narrowing results by meeting topic.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user's ID or email address. Use 'me' to refer to the currently authenticated user.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Filter recordings to those whose topic partially matches this string.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of recordings to return per page (default 30, maximum 300).

200.description: {from, to, page_count, page_number, page_size, total_records, next_page_token, meetings: [{uuid, id, topic, host_id, host_email, start_time, end_time, duration, recording_count, total_size, recording_files}]}

get.summary: Retrieve cloud recording details for a particular meeting using its ID.
get.description: Retrieve cloud recording details for a particular meeting using its ID.

parameters.name: meetingId
parameters.description: The meeting ID or UUID to retrieve recordings for.

200.description: Recording object with uuid, id, topic, host_id, host_email, start_time, end_time, duration, recording_count, total_size, recording_files

get.summary: Fetch a summary for a given meeting by its ID or UUID, including details and current status information.
get.description: Fetch a summary for a given meeting by its ID or UUID, including details and current status information.

parameters.name: meetingId
parameters.description: The meeting ID or UUID to retrieve the summary for.

200.description: {id, uuid, topic, start_time, duration, status, agenda}

uuid.description: Universally unique identifier for this meeting occurrence.

id.description: Meeting ID, shared across all occurrences of the same meeting.

host_id.description: The host's user ID or email address.

topic.description: Title or subject of the meeting.

type.description: 1=Instant meeting, 2=Scheduled meeting, 3=Recurring meeting with no fixed time, 8=Recurring meeting with fixed time.

start_time.description: Scheduled start time of the meeting in UTC (ISO 8601).

duration.description: Length of the meeting in minutes.

timezone.description: Timezone associated with the meeting (e.g., America/Los_Angeles).

agenda.description: Description or agenda notes for the meeting.

start_url.description: URL the meeting host uses to start the session.

join_url.description: URL that attendees use to join the meeting.

password.description: Meeting passcode (up to 10 characters, alphanumeric plus @-_*).

audio.description: Audio mode: voip, telephony, or both.

auto_recording.description: Recording destination: none, local, or cloud.

waiting_room.description: Toggles the waiting room feature on or off.

org.description: The registrant's company or organization name.

host_id.description: User ID of the meeting host.

host_email.description: Email address of the meeting host.

recording_count.description: How many recording files are associated with this meeting.

total_size.description: Combined size of all recording files, in bytes.

recording_files.description: Collection of individual recording file objects.
